# Security Policy

I take the security of this add-on seriously, including as a fork building
on top of the upstream Home Assistant Community Add-ons project.

If you believe you have found a security vulnerability in this repository,
please report it responsibly as described below.

**Please DO NOT report security vulnerabilities publicly!**

So... DO NOT create a GitHub issue for it ;)

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting for this repository:

1. Go to the [Security tab](https://github.com/Alfie51m/addon-vscode/security)
   of this repository.
2. Click **Report a vulnerability**.
3. Fill in as much detail as possible, including:
  - A description of the vulnerability.
  - How it could be exploited.
  - The potential impact (e.g., DOS, privacy concerns, leaking of
    credentials).
  - Steps for reproducing the vulnerability.
  - Code (if any) needed to reproduce the issue.
  - If you have one, an idea for a fix, patch, or other mitigation.

This opens a private discussion between you and me directly on GitHub, so
there's no need for email or PGP - everything happens in one place and stays
private until we agree it's ready to be disclosed.

Please take care not to violate the privacy of other people in your report.
For example, stack traces or exploit scripts you include should never
contain private or personally identifiable information.

## After you have reported the vulnerability

Give me at least a week to investigate and respond, and up to 60 days to
fix and distribute a patch. This includes a window for existing users to
upgrade, patch, or mitigate the issue.

If you intend, at any point, to disclose the vulnerability to someone else
or publicly, please give me reasonable advance notice via the same private
report thread.

If any dependent projects are involved (including the upstream
[hassio-addons](https://github.com/hassio-addons) project this is forked
from), please report it to the relevent maintainers as well.

## Bug bounty

Unfortunately, I cannot offer a paid bug bounty program. I will, however,
give my best effort to show appreciation towards people who take the time
and effort to disclose vulnerabilities responsibly.

## Contact information

For anything not appropriate for GitHub's private vulnerability reporting,
you can reach me via my GitHub profile: [@Alfie51m](https://github.com/Alfie51m).
